# Zahir Choudhry

> Zahir Choudhry is an AI Engineer based in San Francisco, CA. He builds agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and backend infrastructure for VC-backed AI startups, currently as an Associate AI Engineer at Gentoro.ai.

Zahir owns systems end-to-end — from architecture through production — and specializes in LangGraph/MCP agentic workflows, hybrid semantic search, prompt-injection defense, and FastAPI/Next.js backend systems.
